evidence: The PbS films were deposited by the ALE method in a hotwall flow-type reactor F-120 manufactured by Microchemistry Ltd, Espoo, Finland. The primary N2 flow was 0.7 dm3 min-' and the reactor pressure measured from the pumping line was around 3 mbar. The pulse times for lead chemicals and hydrogen mlfide were typically 0.4 s. The purge time normally used was 0.4 s. Typically the number of growth cycles was 10000.
